verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents an 'AI Support Assistant' built into the dashboard that users can consult before opening a support ticket, showing some built-in AI assistant presence. However, this assistant's scope appears limited to support/troubleshooting rather than general task delegation (e.g., building connectors, running syncs, managing transformations via chat) — deeper task automation is instead achieved via external MCP server and third-party coding-agent plugins, not a built-in in-product assistant. Missing for 10: evidence of the assistant performing broad operational tasks beyond support triage, and any documentation of its capabilities/scope beyond the FAQ mention.
